title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Off the Record

entities.name: Jilesa Clarus
entities.description: An eager Silverquill lumimancer and reporter for the Strixhaven Star who helps Professor Zarek and is betrayed by him.

entities.name: Esmun
entities.description: Jilesa's flash artist, a tall companion who paints with spell-canvases and maps the maze.

entities.name: Professor Zarek
entities.description: A stylish new law-mage instructor from Ravnica who manipulates Jilesa and Esmun into helping him steal a tome from the Vaults of Turrau.

entities.name: Professor Goss
entities.description: Jilesa's advisor, who calls her overconfident and impetuous.

entities.name: Namivi Dens
entities.description: A rival journalist who beat Jilesa twice for the Argent Star.

entities.name: Codex Vocifera
entities.description: A sentient codex on creaky metal legs that knows much of the Biblioplex but is restricted by a redaction spell.

entities.name: Mina
entities.description: Jilesa's fellow barista at Firejolt Cafe who points her to the Void.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A professor whom Jilesa suspects may be connected to Zarek's arrival.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker with whom Zarek says he is not on good terms.

entities.name: Isabough
entities.description: A Strixhaven figure Jilesa suggests Zarek could ask.

entities.name: Fain
entities.description: A person Jilesa calls unscrupulous.

entities.name: Scavrana the Oracle
entities.description: Author of the tome Accounts of the Dawning Age.

entities.name: Accounts of the Dawning Age
aliases: Accounts of the Dawning Age: Vortex Formations and Egomagical Adaptations
entities.description: A Blood Age tome with smoky glass-like cover kept in the Vaults of Turrau, which Zarek steals.

entities.name: Vaults of Turrau
entities.description: Hidden vaults at the base of the mountains below Hookiver where Blood Age artifacts are stored under guard.

entities.name: Vault constructs
entities.description: Stone guardians holding spears and shields that attack intruders carrying stolen items.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where the story begins.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's huge library, still being rebuilt after the Phyrexians wrecked it.

entities.name: The Void
entities.description: A silenced zone near the Biblioplex where students scream without being heard.

entities.name: Hookiver
entities.description: Owlin aerie cities above the mountains hiding the vaults.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Zarek's home plane, whose leylines he believes he destabilized.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of rhetoric and spellcasting through words.

entities.name: Inkling
entities.description: Small spell-creatures summoned by Silverquill students from insults and sounds; Jilesa uses them to scout the maze.

events.summary: Jilesa and Esmun go to interview the new instructor Professor Zarek for a puff piece in the Star.
events.quote: Reporter from the Strixhaven Star , here for the interview.

events.summary: In his office Jilesa casts a hidden interrogation spell on Zarek, who breaks it and instead offers her a secret project.
events.quote: Professor Zarek smoothed his hair with one hand, then snapped his fingers above his head.

events.summary: Zarek reveals he is searching for a Blood Age tome about the birth of the elder dragons and that Ravnica's leylines may be destabilized by him.
events.quote: I think the leylines of Ravnica may have been destabilized by … well, me.

events.summary: Jilesa suggests asking the Codex Vocifera, and the three go to find it.
events.quote: Don't just sit there, you two. We've got a codex to catch.

events.summary: They corner the Codex in the Void, which says the book's page is redacted and it cannot tell them its location.
events.quote: The page containing that information is redacted.

events.summary: Jilesa performs a lumimancy ritual with Esmun and Zarek's power to undo the redaction, and the Codex reveals the tome is in the Vaults of Turrau.
events.quote: The tome was taken from the Mystical Archive to the Vaults of Turrau

events.summary: Zarek learns the vault passcode and sets off alone, but Jilesa insists on joining and he relents.
events.quote: Your skills would be very useful. Are you sure you're up to the challenge?

events.summary: The three travel by transport spell to the mountains below Hookiver and find a clearing of skeletons before the vault doors.
events.quote: massive doors led into the sheer side of a cliff, covered in spiraling blue sigils

events.summary: Jilesa tries the maze and is ported back, and they deduce it drains and teleports intruders.
events.quote: One drains us, the other ports us out.

events.summary: Jilesa summons inklings to run the maze while Esmun maps their path, with Zarek lending power.
events.quote: The maze's energy-sapping eventually dispelled the inklings, until only one remained.

events.summary: Skeletons rise as they cross the maze; Esmun burns one away with a flash canvas and Zarek deals with the rest.
events.quote: the skeleton itself burned away, leaving nothing but ashes and a whiff of sulfur.

events.summary: Zarek speaks the passcode and the vault doors open.
events.quote: Slowly, silently, the doors cracked open just enough to allow them to slip inside.

events.summary: Jilesa's truth-spell leads them to the smoky-glass tome and Zarek takes it.
events.quote: He didn't hesitate to take the tome, opening it carefully.

events.summary: The stone constructs activate and demand the stolen item be returned.
events.quote: Return the stolen item or be destroyed.

events.summary: Zarek reveals he manipulated them, takes the book and teleports away, leaving the students to the constructs.
events.quote: Your combination of skill and spiteful ambition was invaluable, as I'd expected

events.summary: Jilesa realizes she was used and prepares to run with Esmun as the constructs close in.
events.quote: This had all been a plot to steal that book?

relations.quote: Two mages are better than one. Maybe I can help, too.

relations.note: He manipulates her and abandons her to the constructs.

relations.quote: Too bad her advisor, Professor Goss, seemed disinclined to encourage her ambitions.

relations.note: Zarek says they are not on the best terms.
relations.quote: We're not on the best terms, and if he finds out about this
They're the constructs Codie warned us about!

relations.note: The tome was moved there from the Mystical Archive.
relations.quote: where many Blood Age artifacts are kept in stasis for safety reasons.
